content.title: Most McDonald's open on Easter Sunday with varied hours
content.text: McDonald's maintains holiday operations Across multiple outlets, McDonald’s confirmed that most U.S. locations will open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026. This aligns with its long-standing pattern of operating on major holidays, making it a dependable option for travelers and those skipping home cooking. However, the company emphasizes that exact hours are set by individual franchisees, not corporate mandates. TheStreet + 2 How hours differ across locations Typical Easter Sunday hours for McDonald’s range from early openings at 5 or 6 a.m. to closings around 10 or 11 p.m., with some drive-thrus running later. High-traffic spots near highways, airports, and tourist areas often maintain extended service, while neighborhood locations may shorten hours due to lighter morning demand from church services. In rare cases, low-traffic sites may close altogether. Newsweek + 1 Competitors show mixed holiday patterns While McDonald’s, Starbucks, Taco Bell, Burger King, and Wendy’s generally remain open on Easter, chains like Chick-fil-A, Chipotle, and Raising Cane’s close entirely. Some brands, such as Sonic Drive-In and Wingstop, operate on a case-by-case basis. This split reflects different corporate strategies on balancing customer demand with giving staff time off. mySA + 2 Best ways to confirm Easter hours Given the variability, McDonald’s advises customers to use its official website or mobile app to check real-time hours, or to call the desired location directly. This approach minimizes inconvenience and ensures diners can plan around family gatherings, travel, or other holiday commitments. The same practice is recommended for other chains with franchise-based operations. mySA + 1 5 references More for you
